findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_job_posting, get_account, get_applications, get_interviews, get_mailbox, get_line, get_outreach · Private data: get_applications, get_resume_studio, get_mailbox, manage_outreach, get_contacts, manage_contacts, manage_assistant, get_website, manage_website, get_connections, manage_connections · Public sink: whoami, update_settings, send_email, get_outreach, manage_website, manage_connections · Destructive: delete_account, run_setup, manage_answers, manage_interview_practice, manage_calendar, manage_outreach, manage_contacts, manage_assistant, manage_website, manage_connections.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_job_posting, get_account, get_applications, get_interviews, get_mailbox, get_line, get_outreach · Private data: get_applications, get_resume_studio, get_mailbox, manage_outreach, get_contacts, manage_contacts, manage_assistant, get_website, manage_website, get_connections, manage_connections · Public sink: whoami, update_settings, send_email, get_outreach, manage_website, manage_connections · Destructive: delete_account, run_setup, manage_answers, manage_interview_practice, manage_calendar, manage_outreach, manage_contacts, manage_assistant, manage_website, manage_connections

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
